claims.claim: The Shadow of the Torturer narration sample has the highest rare-word rate of the four, 18.05 per cent of tokens outside the 10,000-word Google frequency list's top 5,000, against 17.41 per cent for 1972, 11.89 per cent for 2013 and 11.04 per cent for 2015.
